===SPINOFF Tournaments AKA. Bronze/Silver Tournaments===

====Introduction====
Blaps asked me to do some spinoff tournaments for teams/players dropping out of the main tournaments.

All teams getting dropped from the main tournaments will get a spot in the spinoff tournaments.

If a player/team doesn't wan't to participate in the spinoff tournament they can just give WO.

/Zalon

====Schedule====

The spinoff tournaments have no schedule, and matches should be played whenever you aren't active in one of the main tournaments.

====Reporting====

Matches should be reported in the '''#report-your-spinoff-here''' to not confuse the main match reports.
